question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/431eacfa06cda6d95000dc76536116c7163449eb22f1b2623fcc4cceb81dfcb8
.png] 

The logic follows here is :

**Alternate letters are reverse of each other.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b68a97135f2d87d746d54104bf4c6f322b1ad98cc6a9ee49f5383f7c5cb60bcd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"JTPG".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

**Sum of place values of reverse letters = 27.**

e.g. I (9) + R (18) = 27.
